## Verdict: PASS for DG0 round 10

Reviewed the frozen candidate `sha256:1e959f25…0c54` at commit `85a0efa`. Every check I ran passed. F-DG0-224 is fixed. There is one new finding: it is Low and non-mandatory, and I'd accept it as an observation.

**Candidate confirmation:** HEAD is `474b8d7`, a commit that only adds round-10 assignments, the candidate manifest and `stages.json`. The candidate ID I recomputed in the main tree and in a disposable worktree at `85a0efa` matches the manifest.

**Checks run** (disposable worktree and clones, all removed afterwards):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `check_extraction.sh` | PASS: docx hash matches, 165 playbook blocks, 423 master-prompt blocks |
| Gate validator self-tests | 41/41 PASS |
| Write-guard tests | 15/15 PASS |
| `--register DG0`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile`, `candidate.mjs` | all PASS, exit 0 |
| `prefreeze.sh DG0` in a fresh clone | all steps PASS, exit 0 |
| My round-9 negative suite on the new candidate | 94/94 PASS |
| 8 new round-10 tests (`dg0-gate-negative-r10.test.mjs`) | 8/8 PASS on the candidate; 7 of 8 fail on the round-9 commit, so they catch the old defects |
| Register integrity script | PASS, 0 errors: 411 rows, 19 DG0 rows IMPLEMENTED, none VERIFIED, A01–A28 all covered, both coverage matrices complete (165 and 423 blocks) |
| Agent-load evidence | PASS: 10 runs, 10 distinct sessions, orchestrator model; all 10 hook commands identical between agent definitions and settings, use `MTH_GUARD_ROOT` and pass their own role |
| Feasibility | PASS: every A01–A28 scenario has a test level, stage and gate |
| Live guard probe | all three probe writes blocked: `docs/source/QA-PROBE.txt` in the main repo, and `docs/source/QA-PROBE.txt` and `tools/gates/QA-PROBE.mjs` in my worktree; a scratch write outside the repository was allowed |

The new round-10 tests cover the worktree and path fixes, none of which the existing tests covered:
- a worktree with a tampered copy of the guard;
- the hook blocking all writes when `MTH_GUARD_ROOT` is unset, empty, nonexistent or has no guard, for all 10 roles;
- the root variable pointing at a linked worktree;
- worktrees at paths with spaces and Arabic characters;
- symlinks, capitalisation variants and the worktree's `.git` file;
- a worktree nested inside the repository;
- the candidate ID not depending on where the repository is checked out;
- the validator rejecting bad input with a message, not a crash, under an unusual path.

## Verification of my earlier finding
- **F-DG0-224 (Low): CLOSED_VERIFIED.** On the round-9 commit, cloned under a path with a space and Arabic characters, every validator mode crashes with ENOENT. On `85a0efa` at the same path, the validator modes, all 56 self-tests, prefreeze and my original regression test pass. No other use of the broken path decoding remains under `tools/`.

## New finding
- **F-DG0-225 (Low, non-mandatory; owner: delivery-orchestrator).** Decision D-023 says the worktree fix was "verified live" with a backend-workflow-engineer run, and the F-DG0-134 fix summary also cites a "live worktree probe". No run directory or evidence file records that probe. The behaviour itself is correct: my new tests and my live probe both confirm it. So this only affects traceability of that claim. Either attach the probe evidence or reword D-023 in the next candidate.

Several tests I wrote along the way didn't work at first because of my own mistakes, not the product: the new round-10 tests had a fixture error (a worktree name with a space isn't a valid branch name), and two of my checks had shell-quoting errors. I fixed all of them and reran; none is a product defect.

While listing files, I saw the names of other reviewers' round-10 evidence files. I didn't open any of them, and none influenced this verdict.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG0/round-10/qa-verifier.json` (review record; validates against the schema, all 48 evidence entries exist)
- `reviews/DG0/round-10/qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `reviews/DG0/round-10/qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `test-evidence/DG0/qa/round-10/` (logs 01–10)
- `test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/dg0-gate-negative-r10.test.mjs` (to be promoted into `tests/qa/dg0/` in the next stage)
